description: Check whether a URL has an archived snapshot in the Wayback Machine, optionally closest to a given timestamp. Returns availability, the archived snapshot URL, and its capture timestamp (Internet Archive Wayback Availability API)

timestamp.description: Find the snapshot closest to this timestamp, format YYYYMMDDhhmmss (e.g. "20260101" for Jan 1 2026). Omit for the most recent snapshot

url.description: The live URL to check for an archived snapshot in the Wayback Machine (e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com/page")

name: archiveorg.wayback.check_availability

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Check Wayback Machine Availability
